title: Vertical Limit
desc: When his sister Annie gets trapped in a crevice atop K2 along with her crew, mountain climber Peter Garrett must assemble a team to rescue them before they perish.

title: Zombieland: Double Tap
desc: Columbus, Tallahassee, Wichita, and Little Rock move to the American heartland as they face off against evolved zombies, fellow survivors, and the growing pains of the snarky makeshift family.

title: Morbius
desc: Suffering from a rare blood disorder, Dr. Morbius takes a risky leap to cure himself and others, inadvertently unleashing a dark and unforeseen consequence.

title: Spider-Man: Far from Home
desc: A shy teenager, imbued with spider-like abilities after a bite, becomes a masked superhero battling injustice and confronting a vengeful foe in a thrilling conflict.

title: Little Women
desc: A heartfelt story of four sisters growing up, exploring love, ambition, and family bonds as they navigate life's challenges and pursue their dreams.

title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
desc: A single mother inherits her estranged father's farmhouse and moves in with her children, uncovering their family's hidden legacy connected to the legendary Ghostbusters.

title: Hotel Transylvania: Transformania
desc: A science experiment goes wrong: Johnny becomes a monster while others turn human. Now the group must find a way to reverse it before it's permanent.

title: Drunken Master
desc: Suffering humiliation from a hired assassin, Wong Fei-Hung returns to his uncle's kung fu school with revenge on his mind.

title: Men In Black: International
desc: When aliens that have the ability to shape-shift into humans arrive on Earth, Agent H joins forces with Agent M, a new recruit, to save the planet.

title: Bloodshot
desc: A man enhanced with cutting-edge technology battles powerful enemies and confronts his lost memories in a mission of retribution.

title: Erin Brockovich
desc: Julia Roberts won an Oscar for her role in this inspiring true story. A single mom becomes a legal assistant and takes on a company that is polluting a city's water supply.
